title: Normalize newlines in ElementInternals's setValidity()
body:
setCustomValidity() normalizes newlines in its argument as of
904aba1d7d475899ccc7c6679ac8c5c9017ca70f, but setValidity() did not, so
the same message ended up normalized or not depending on which API set
the custom validity error message. Normalize message once, before it is
used for both the validation message and the custom validity error
message.
